name: growth.provider.acquisition
description: Systematically identify, reach out to, and onboard new healthcare providers. The funnel: Identify → Qualify → Reach → Convert → Onboard.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Identify target provider segments
steps.prompt: Identify the top 5 underserved medical specialties that would benefit most from telehealth. For each: specialty name, estimated TAM, pain points telehealth solves, and best outreach channel. Think strategically.

steps.name: Craft personalized outreach templates
steps.prompt: Create 3 outreach email templates for inviting doctors to join DoctaRx telehealth platform. Tone: professional, empathetic, value-first. Include: subject line, body, CTA. Highlight: instant credentialing, patient access, revenue growth.
